invariants.statement: Every unit has exactly one owning slice and a task set consistent with the T007 register.
Only an exact issued handle mutates, closes, or replaces an active resource.
Immutable values and static artifacts are shared without synchronization.
Every shared mutable state is protected by a declared synchronization mechanism or boundary.
Every queue, quota, depth, rate, byte, and retry bound is finite and declared with its source.
No unit silently retries or silently upgrades delivery guarantees.
An unknown or incomplete outcome is never reported as success.
Every public C/C++ interface documents its ownership, lifetime, thread-safety, and failure contract.
Payload views have an explicit bounded lifetime and metadata-only is the observation default.
Synthetic provenance survives routing, observation, and restart classification.
Dependencies flow one-way blueprints to profiles to XDL/platform to runtime; subsystem naming is preserved.
No core unit embeds a domain-specific primitive (ECU, CAN, SOME/IP, Zenoh, or a product name).
The first proof executes no legacy workload, contacts no external peer, and exposes no TCP listener except the host-protected local tool gateway.
Every unit declares explicit, classified failure semantics and planned evidence.
